Subjects

Philosophy and theology

Kalām, philosophy, metaphysics and belief.

Theology here means kalām, doctrine (ʿaqīda) and metaphysics as modern authors reread them. Some defend a classical creed, as Ali Gomaa does for the Ashʿari-Māturīdī position. Some rebuild metaphysics for the present: al-Attas, Seyyed Hossein Nasr and Frithjof Schuon. Fazlur Rahman started from what the Qur'an itself says about God, humanity and society.

A large number of entries are short Urdu and Arabic works by Abul Hasan Ali Nadwi, and Yaqeen Institute papers on belief and prophethood.

Where to begin

A reading order, earliest first. Each title opens the text or the free copy.

  1. 1980 · Book
    Major Themes of the Qur'an ↗ Fazlur Rahman

    Rahman's overview of the Qur'an's teaching on God, man and society.

  2. 1981 · Book
    Knowledge and the Sacred ↗ Seyyed Hossein Nasr

    Nasr's Gifford Lectures on the loss of sacred knowledge in modern thought.

  3. 1995 · Collection
    Prolegomena to the Metaphysics of Islam: An Exposition of the Fundamental Elements of the Worldview of Islam ↗ Syed Muhammad Naquib al-Attas

    Al-Attas on the metaphysical vision at the root of Muslim thought.

  4. 2011 · Book
    The Creed of the People of the Sunna and the Community ('Aqidat ahl al-sunna wa-al-jama'a) ↗ Ali Gomaa

    A concise statement of the creed of the Sunni majority tradition by the former Mufti of Egypt.

  5. 2017 · Paper
    Does God Exist? The Case for Allah’s Existence in the Quran and Sunnah ↗ Yaqeen Institute for Islamic Research

    Yaqeen's argument for the existence of God from the Qur'an and Sunna.
